scope: pi.rpc only; no Pi SDK sidecar, Oh My Pi, provider API or public operation claim
complete_tree_inventory: dist-inventory.json; recursively lists every npm package file and its SHA-256 at all 12 points; per-hop added/removed/changed/identical path sets are hashed

configuration_and_mcp.0.87.1: --no-extensions disables extension discovery; no explicit -e path is sent
configuration_and_mcp.0.99.0: upstream help and resource loader define --no-extensions to omit discovered and built-in extension paths; route passes this flag
configuration_and_mcp.1.0.4: --tools allows MCP tools unless an mcp__ entry is named, and --no-mcp is available; route keeps --no-extensions and supplies no extension paths, so the built-in MCP extension is not loaded
configuration_and_mcp.1.1.0: --tools modifier parsing is stricter; selected plain tool allowlist remains valid, and --no-extensions still omits extensions

command_dispositions.handled_prompt: No agent run starts; adapter fails the requested prompt without waiting for agent_settled
command_dispositions.handled_steer_or_follow_up: Input is consumed and not queued; adapter reports rejection and releases its pending slot
command_dispositions.queued_or_started: Continue under existing acknowledgement, event, terminal and cleanup lifecycle

agent_settled_aborted.shape: agent_settled.aborted is a required boolean in the exact current type; RPC forwards the session event
agent_settled_aborted.false: Existing normal completion and token usage checks remain
agent_settled_aborted.true: Project existing terminal cancellation; caller cancellation and deadline retain precedence
agent_settled_aborted.older_points: Field remains optional on older qualified points; current point rejects a missing value

unchanged.strict_lf_jsonl: same selected framing; dist/modes/rpc/jsonl.js is byte-identical across the compared points
unchanged.failure_and_permission: RPC error envelope, abort behavior, UI callbacks, retry suppression and no-permission surface remain as previously qualified
unchanged.usage: Decoder continues to project input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite from assistant message_end; nested tool-result usage is not admitted as assistant usage
unchanged.public_operations: No new or removed selected RPC command; provider session switching and durable state remain excluded
